name: external_pathetic_loadlibrary_ac
description: Public DLL with MinHook/OpenGL hook, delivered through Xenos native loader. Primary label is injection; intra-process hooks are secondary mechanisms, not a pure cross-process hook example. Operator-driven capture; no manipulation section.

extra.provenance: docs/external-cheats/README.md; fill actual tool/game hashes and runtime version before collection.
extra.operator_commands: Launch Xenos.exe, select the printed AC PID, and add External_Cheats\AC\PatheticAssaultCube\Release\AssaultCube-Internal.dll. In Advanced choose Native inject; thread hijack, unlinking, PE-header erasure and kernel options OFF. Inject once. Confirm the DLL loaded and press F in AC to show its menu. Enable only ESP for 30 seconds. Leave the DLL/game running and press Enter in the capture shell; let the runner finish cooldown and terminate AC.
extra.success_criterion: Verify intended effect using game state, tool log, or payload marker independently of detector output. Record failed pilots separately.
extra.notes: Fresh AC and the same local bot match per replicate. See docs/external-cheats/evaluation-plan.md. Keep AC alive through cooldown; runner performs final cleanup.
extra.secondary_mechanisms: intra-process MinHook inline hook + window-procedure replacement; other feature writes kept off
